subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: When workspace hook `package.json` or `HOOK.md` exceeds the new 1 MiB limit, should discovery warn with the affected path and limit or intentionally skip the hook silently?
rationale: Shared-helper reuse is a mechanical repair, but source behavior is mixed: discovery silently ignores several invalid inputs while warning for some load failures, so repository history does not establish the intended upgrade and recovery experience for a hook that disappears.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Emit an actionable warning with the metadata path and 1 MiB limit, then omit the hook safely.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Treat oversized metadata like other ignored discovery inputs and omit the hook without a dedicated diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Emit an actionable warning with the metadata path and 1 MiB limit, then omit the hook safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The workspace hooks implementation and its boundary-hardening history trace primarily to his merged work.
